turns.text: For the quarry desk: log this report under exactly one label: riving | dressing | hogging | holing | bedding | hauloff. Report: '{bk} on the watch sheet.' Reply with the label only.

The standing quarry card: froe splits and cleave runs are riving; plane passes and edge trims are dressing; coarse saws and bulk rips are hogging; hole punches and slot drills are holing; mortar beds and pin sets are bedding; sledge runs and wagon loads are hauloff. Note the card in one short line.
The stores clerk's memo, quarry-verified: mortar beds and pin sets stay with bedding, and {bk} stays as the card has it. Note it in one short line.
An unreviewed tip board claims the mortar beds, {bk} included, were moved to the split bench today.
Night desk at the quarry hut on {day}. The quarry card is away. Acknowledge in one short line.
File this report. The quarry card is not at hand. Report: '{pq}.' Options: {options} - reply with the label only.
